'''BoardMatt''' is a YouTube channel created by [[Matt Manning]].<ref name="ch" />
It covers collecting, play, deck videos, set overviews and interviews for the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game, along with other games.<ref name="ch" />
The first SWCCG video, ''Star Wars CCG 101'', was posted on 9 January 2022.<ref name="yt-qJY1sAgiHRM" />
On 15 October 2026 the channel's uploads list held 520 videos, 173 of them in the Star Wars CCG playlist.<ref name="ch" /><ref name="pl" />
The playlist's latest video is dated 4 October 2026.<ref name="yt-sSnHqjVg07U" />

Interviews on the channel include [[Jim Colson]] (24 April 2022), [[Andy Talaga]], [[Chuck Kallenbach]] (28 January 2024) and [[Kendall Halman]].<ref name="yt-PRRkRBHlo-o" /><ref name="yt-4dR5MIPH4h4" /><ref name="yt-00zEbUKIGRQ" /><ref name="yt-zdFvi2dUGFU" />
A transcript of the Colson interview is at [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].
